questions.question: A page lists three ingredients whose order does not matter. Which element should wrap the list items?
questions.explanation: An unordered list groups items whose order carries no meaning.

questions.question: Which CSS declaration sets the foreground text color of a paragraph to navy?
questions.explanation: The color property sets the foreground color used for ordinary text.

questions.question: A photo conveys information that is missing from the surrounding text. Where should its concise text alternative go?
questions.explanation: The alt attribute gives assistive technology a text alternative when the image conveys meaning.
